title: 段落定位词
goal: 选择具体定位线索并查找候选段落。

points.label: 选择具有区分度的定位词
用定位线索找到候选段落

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 定位词是陈述里能指向某一段的具体信息。全文反复出现的主题词每段都有，区分不了段落。找到候选段后，还要核对动作和对象。

body.box:
Statement: Mira borrowed a projector.
Paragraph: Mira borrowed a projector for the town meeting.

body.p: Mira 和 projector 一起缩小查找范围。再核对动作 borrowed，两句一致才算对应。

cards.title: 定位线索
rows: Nora sorted the letters by date.
The River Museum collected old tickets.
The survey continued for fourteen days.
多段重复 library；globe 更具体。

body.box:
A. The school installed a bicycle shelter beside the hall.
B. The school moved its bicycle repair class to the hall.

Statement: A covered place for bicycles was built near the hall.

body.p: 两段都有 school 和 bicycle。covered place 对应 shelter，was built 对应 installed，所以第一段符合陈述。
第二段讲维修课搬到礼堂，没有提到建车棚。用具体线索找到候选段后，仍要核对动作。

groups.text: A. Lena repaired a camera. B. Omar repaired a clock.

items.stem: Which pair of person and object locates 'Omar repaired a clock'?
items.why: Omar 和 clock 共同指向第二段的具体人物及物件。

groups.text: A. A concert lasted twenty minutes. B. A concert began at twenty past seven.

items.why: lasted twenty minutes 对应持续 20 分钟。

groups.text: A. The Hill Reading Centre (HRC) opened a room. B. The Hill Reading Centre held a talk.

items.stem: Which additional clue distinguishes the room statement?
items.why: 两个段落的机构名相同；opened a room 指出第一段的动作和对象。

groups.text: A. A team washed glass jars. B. A team stored seeds in glass jars.

items.why: stored seeds in glass jars 指出保存的对象。

groups.text:
A. The Coastal Archive (CA) received old maps from Iris. Staff placed them in a cabinet.
B. The Coastal Archive displayed maps of bridges. Visitors could examine copies.
C. The Coastal Archive lent a cabinet to a school. It also sent copies of photographs.

items.stem: Which clue best distinguishes the statement that Iris supplied maps?
items.why: Iris 和 maps 共同指向第一段；机构名出现在各段。

items.stem: Where did the archive lend a cabinet to a school?
items.why: 第三段 lent a cabinet to a school 明确给出借出动作及对象。

groups.text: A. The East Food Council (EFC) surveyed twelve markets. B. The EFC visited twelve schools. C. The EFC published a guide to local markets.

items.stem: Which clue distinguishes the market survey?
items.why: surveyed markets 同时限定动作和对象。

items.stem: Which paragraph reports visits to 12 schools?
items.why: 第二段 visited twelve schools 中 twelve 对应数字 12。

groups.text:
A. The Westside Craft Centre (WCC) keeps a collection of tools used in local workshops. This year, its staff asked residents to identify unfamiliar objects in the collection. One resident, Ada, recognized a wooden tool used to shape clay. She explained how her family had used it and allowed staff to record her explanation for the centre's visitors. Her account helped staff distinguish the tool from others of a similar shape.

B. The WCC also wanted to improve the way its tools were displayed. A carpenter named Ben made a cabinet with glass doors for the centre. He designed the shelves so that visitors could see small objects without touching them. Staff arranged the clay tools on one shelf and added labels based on information in the centre's records. The cabinet stood near the entrance, where visitors could consult the labels.

C. Another activity at the centre involved a group of students. They photographed sixteen tools and wrote short descriptions for an online catalogue. The students checked each description with staff before publishing it. They did not photograph every object in the collection, but their work made a selection available to people who could not visit the centre.

D. At a later meeting, the WCC invited local teachers to discuss the collection. The teachers suggested a class in which pupils would compare modern and older tools. Staff agreed to prepare copies of photographs for the class. They also planned to ask residents for more information about objects whose uses remained uncertain.

items.stem: Which clue best locates the account of Ada identifying a clay tool?
items.why: Ada 与 clay tool 同时指向第一段中的人物和物件。

items.stem: Which paragraph describes a cabinet built by Ben?
items.why: Ben made a cabinet with glass doors 位于第二段。

items.stem: Which clue distinguishes the online catalogue from the teachers' class?
items.why: photographed sixteen tools 和 online catalogue 同在第三段。第二项 copies of photographs 在第四段，属于教师提议的课程。

items.stem: Which paragraph reports a proposal to compare old and modern tools?
items.why: teachers suggested a class ... compare modern and older tools 位于第四段。

groups.text:
A. The North Ferry Office (NFO) held a public meeting about travel across the river. One passenger, Rosa, described the difficulty of carrying a folded bicycle onto a crowded boat. The office recorded her comment along with other passengers' suggestions. The meeting concerned access to existing services rather than the purchase of new boats. Notes from the meeting were kept at the office for later discussion by staff.

B. After the meeting, the NFO asked a designer to examine the space near the ferry entrance. The designer proposed a marked area for folded bicycles. Staff tested the plan on one boat before deciding whether to use it elsewhere. During the test, they also kept the ordinary seats available to passengers. The marked area gave staff a consistent place to direct people carrying folded bicycles.

C. The office later counted passengers on eight evening trips. The count included people travelling with bicycles and people travelling without them. Staff used the figures to identify the busiest departures. They compared the numbers with earlier records, but the figures did not explain why individual passengers chose a particular departure.

D. To make the results available, the NFO printed a short report and placed copies at the terminal. It also sent the report to the local bus company, whose vehicles stop near the ferry. The company used the information when reviewing connections. The ferry office kept collecting passenger comments after the report appeared. The printed copies allowed passengers to read the results while waiting at the terminal.

items.stem: Which clue best distinguishes Rosa's comment from the designer's proposal?
items.why: Rosa 与 crowded boat 指向第一段的乘客意见。

items.stem: Which paragraph describes a trial of a marked bicycle area?
items.why: 第二段 proposed a marked area 和 tested the plan 说明试用。

items.stem: Which clue locates the count of 8 evening journeys?
items.why: eight evening trips 与 8 evening journeys 对应，限定了次数和时段。

items.stem: Which paragraph mentions sending a report to a bus company?
items.why: 第四段 sent the report to the local bus company 明确给出接收方。
